title: Structured Taupe Textured Top-Handle Handbag
material: textured faux leather with smooth leather trim
description: A neat structured handbag in soft taupe, combining a woven-texture front panel with smooth leather trim and rolled top handles. Gold-tone handle anchors and a small front plaque add a polished finish, while the zip top keeps everything secure.
seo_description: Structured taupe top-handle handbag in textured faux leather with gold-tone hardware and a secure zip top.
